name: SEO Rank Hunter
author: Adnan Hyder Pervez

sections.description:
SEO Rank Hunter improves your site’s visibility, speed, and technical health without forcing you to deal with complicated settings. It is built for site owners who want clean automation, faster loading times, and search-engine-ready content.

The plugin automatically enhances your site by handling essential SEO tasks and front-end optimizations. It works perfectly with most modern themes and plugins while keeping your site safe, stable, and fast.

SEO Rank Hunter includes automated features such as optimized meta titles, cleaner HTML output, script and style cleanup, and performance headers. These improvements help search engines crawl your website more efficiently and give your visitors a smoother browsing experience.

If you want professional SEO help or want to fully optimize your business website, visit
https://xpertcodes.com/seo-rank-hunter

Our team provides advanced SEO services, technical audits, and custom integration support.

Features

  1. Automated meta title and description generation for better search visibility.
  2. Cleanup of unused scripts and styles to reduce page weight.
  3. Built-in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript minification when supported by your theme.
  4. Essential security and performance headers added automatically.
  5. Simple, user-friendly settings panel inside the WordPress dashboard.

Every feature can be enabled or disabled individually from
Settings → SEO Rank Hunter.

Support & SEO Services

https://xpertcodes.com/seo-rank-hunter/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the seo-rank-hunter folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or upload the ZIP through the WordPress Plugin Installer.
  2. Activate SEO Rank Hunter from the Plugins page.
  3. Open Settings → SEO Rank Hunter and adjust your preferences.
  4. Clear any caching plugin or server cache after saving changes.
sections.faq:
Does SEO Rank Hunter replace full SEO tools?

The plugin handles automated on-page tasks and performance improvements. You can use it alongside larger SEO plugins but avoid enabling similar features in multiple plugins to prevent duplication.

Will it conflict with caching plugins?

SEO Rank Hunter works smoothly with most caching solutions. If you notice double-minification or layout issues, disable minification in either plugin.

Does it modify my actual posts or database?

No. All optimization runs at output level. When you deactivate the plugin, your site returns to its normal state.
